ModMetaData.name: Ponies of the Rim
ModMetaData.author: Snowpity.com, MIX333
ModMetaData.description:
Fan-made mod that adds new pony races from the popular TV-show - <color=#ff3a99>My Little Pony™</color>.
Mod overview: > 3 new races: Earth ponies, Pegasi and Unicorns. They are herbivore and have different stats from each other. > Over 500 pony names, 80+ backstories, 150+ cutiemarks, 20+ hair and tail styles. > 2 new scenario, 1 new storyteller and 3 new factions. > Lots of content for DLCs: new genes, ideologies, abilities and more! > New pony-related items and things to play around with. > Ponies can wear human clothes with a custom look for their bodies. > High compatability with other mods.
<color=#00B8FF>Ponies of the Rim: Core</color> <color=#FFD800>v1.2</color> for RimWorld v1.6.4566
